headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Tyler Soderstrom has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics due to left hip impingement. The move is retroactive to August 15, 2026. Other notable injuries include Masataka Yoshida's left hamstring strain and Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s concussion, both of which have led to their respective teams placing them on the injured list.

The Milwaukee Brewers have bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash. The Boston Red Sox have also made a trade, sending center fielder Harold Rivas to the Baltimore Orioles as part of the Adley Rutschman trade.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Joshua Báez leading the offense with 3 hits, 3 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Michael McGreevy earned the win, pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Drew Gilbert led the Rockies' offense with a 3-hit, 3-RBI game.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Tyler Soderstrom on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics left fielder Tyler Soderstrom has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left hip impingement. The move is retroactive to August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their roster with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
